title: Spring Boot + Spring Security Setup
last_note: Edited the already-generated pom.xml (removed data-jpa/validation/spring-kafka per Tech Lead's HTTP-only resolution, added spring-boot-starter-security + shared-java-lib), converted application.properties to application.yml (dev/prod profiles, virtual threads), authored AdminRoleAuthenticationFilter/SecurityConfig/AdminAuthenticationEntryPoint/AdminAccessDeniedHandler, wired ExceptionHandlingConfig (@Import GlobalExceptionHandler) for MVC-level errors, and added a trivial GET /admin/ping controller to prove the chain end-to-end. Verified with mvnw compile (clean) and a live spring-boot:run smoke test: no header -> 403 with {code,message,traceId} envelope, X-User-Role: admin -> 200 pong, wrong role -> 403, /actuator/health -> 200 with no header. All 4 acceptance criteria PASS.
